devou-park.mobility.2: The Devou Park natural surface trails are closed to all users - hikers, runners, and bikers - during and immediately following heavy rains.
Fortunately, even if the natural surface trails are closed, there are numerous paved paths available throughout Devou Park and surrounding neighborhoods.
devou-park.chronic.2: Located inside the Devou Golf & Event Center , where Park Drive meets Golfview Drive, our Welcome Center provides park maps , restrooms and a team of friendly staff members who are ready to answer questions and offer recommendations about exploring the park.
For assistance while navigating the park, our Park Rangers are also available to help. You’ll find them patrolling the grounds or you can reach them directly at 859-801-3592 .
devou-park.mobility.3: All our covered picnic shelters are ADA accessible.
devou-park.cognitive.2: Enter via Parkway Avenue to access the lots at Gus Sheehan Park and Prisoners Lake
Enter via Devou Drive to access the lots at Drees Pavilion , Memorial Overlook and Volpenhein Pavilion
florence-yalls-thomas-more-stadium.mobil: Accessible seating is available behind Sections 107 & 109.
ADA parking is available along the first base line on the back side of the stadium
florence-yalls-thomas-more-stadium.chron: Changing tables are available in family restrooms.
florence-yalls-thomas-more-stadium.cogni: Bags must be clear unless they are smaller than 4.5" x 6.5".
Medically necessary items and diapers may be brought into the stadium, and a bag will be provided if needed
smale-riverfront-park.chronic.1: Smale Riverfront Park Pichler Fountain Restrooms near the Carol Ann’s Carousel: open 8 a.m. - 9 p.m.
smale-riverfront-park.cognitive.1: Open 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM After 9 PM minors (17 and younger) must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
